cases.title: Linear
cases.fx:
g, x, w, b, _ = base(bias=True)
h = g.call_function(mm, (x, w))
y = g.call_function(add, (h, b))
g.output(y)
model = fx.GraphModule(nn.Module(), g)

cases.title: Shared computation + residual
cases.equation: h = x @ w; y = relu(h) + h
cases.fx:
g, x, w, _, _ = base()
h = g.call_function(mm, (x, w))
r = g.call_function(relu, (h,))
y = g.call_function(add, (r, h))
g.output(y)
model = fx.GraphModule(nn.Module(), g)

cases.title: Lazy conditional with shared work
cases.equation: h = x @ w; y = cond(c, h + x, h - x)
cases.fx:
g, x, w, _, c = base(condition=True)
root = nn.Module()
t, f = cond_modules(g, root, add, sub)
h = g.call_function(mm, (x, w))
r = g.call_function(torch.ops.higher_order.cond,
                    (c, t, f, (h, x)))
y = g.call_function(operator.getitem, (r, 0))
g.output(y)
model = fx.GraphModule(root, g)
